|game_text=Deploy from under [[Scoundrel's Luck]] on a scoundrel. Scoundrel is power +2 and his total weapon destiny is +1. During your control phase, may draw destiny. If destiny > 3, your Force drains at same and related locations are +1 for remainder of turn.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelsingenuity-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Ingenuity.png]]). The later errata version is [[Scoundrel's Ingenuity (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Scoundrel is power +2 and his total weapon destiny is +1. During your control phase, may draw destiny. If destiny > 3, your Force drains at same and related locations are +1 for remainder of turn.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelsingenuity-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Ingenuity.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 29) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scoundrel's Ingenuity (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “his total weapon destiny is +1” to “adds 1 to his total weapon destiny”<ref name="cl-1281_36-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Scoundrel is power +2 and adds 1 to his total weapon destiny. During your control phase, may draw destiny. If destiny > 3, your Force drains at same and related locations are +1 for remainder of turn.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Ingenuity-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
